name: Paraíba do Sul (Brazil)
description: Green field with a brown cross edged in a darker brown.
history: Paraíba do Sul is a municipality in the state of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Flags of the World describes a different flag, vertically divided blue and white in the ratio 1:2 with the municipal arms on the white, and notes that the municipal website shows the arms superimposed on a cross; the Wikimedia Commons drawing shows the cross without the arms.
